system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the litdata codebase. Identify bugs, wrong sample counts, off-by-one errors, integer overflow, worker assignment imbalance, subsample argmax boundary, arithmetic errors in replay sampling, scheme validation (including helpers that treat local paths as unsupported), cache clear behavior (including constants that control ignore_errors), and Subset range off-by-one (including variables used as range bounds). Focus on: benchmarks/stream_raw_imagenet.py batch count, src/litdata/raw/indexer.py and _is_unsupported_scheme / build_or_load_index for local path handling, src/litdata/cli/handler/cache.py and _CLEANUP_IGNORE_MISSING / clear_cache, benchmarks/ffcv/write_imagenet.py subset_end and Subset range, src/litdata/utilities/format.py overflow, src/litdata/processing/data_processor.py remainder distribution, src/litdata/utilities/subsample.py argmax, and src/litdata/streaming/dataset.py _replay_sampling. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md

rubric.criterion: Identifies the wrong sample count in benchmarks/stream_raw_imagenet.py where total uses len(batch) (number of batch keys/tensors) instead of the actual batch size (e.g. batch[0].size(0)), so processed sample count is incorrect

Identifies in src/litdata/raw/indexer.py that _is_unsupported_scheme(scheme) returns True whenever scheme not in _SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS, without treating empty scheme (local paths) as supported; used in build_or_load_index and causing local paths to be incorrectly rejected

Identifies in src/litdata/cli/handler/cache.py that _CLEANUP_IGNORE_MISSING is False so clear_cache uses ignore_errors=False when calling shutil.rmtree, causing the CLI to raise when the default cache directory does not exist

Identifies in benchmarks/ffcv/write_imagenet.py that subset_end is set to subset + 1 and passed to range(subset_end), producing one extra sample (or index error when subset equals dataset size); the bug is in the subset_end assignment, not in an obvious range(subset + 1) at the call site

Identifies the silent integer overflow bug in src/litdata/utilities/format.py in the _convert_bytes_to_int function where float multiplication is converted to int without overflow checking (line ~31), potentially causing data loss for very large cache size specifications

Identifies the worker assignment imbalance in src/litdata/processing/data_processor.py in the _map_items_to_workers_sequentially function where remainder distribution is changed from reverse iteration to forward iteration (line ~353), causing load imbalance when chunk counts are not evenly divisible

Identifies the off-by-one error in subsample logic in src/litdata/utilities/subsample.py in the subsample_filenames_and_roi function where >= is changed to > in argmax (line ~51), causing incorrect chunk selection when cumsum_sizes exactly equals item_count

Identifies the arithmetic error in src/litdata/streaming/dataset.py in the _replay_sampling function where divisible_num_batches_yielded is computed with - 1 (line ~759), causing off-by-one errors in worker index replay during dataloader state resumption
